observation_indicators.observable_fil: May gawain, responsable, kumpirmasyon ng resources, petsa, panukat at magalang na follow-up kasama ang komunidad.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Includes an action, owner, resource confirmation, date, measure and respectful community follow-up.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Hindi kumpirmadong resources ang ipinapangako o ipinapahiya ang hindi nakatapos.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Promises unconfirmed resources or shames someone who did not finish.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Kumpleto ang plano; sinusuri ang natanggap na balita, hindi pagdalo lamang; may pag-aangkop sa hadlang nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Completes the plan, measures receipt of updates beyond attendance and adapts to barriers without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May tao at petsa pero kailangang paalalahanang kumpirmahin ang resources o magdagdag ng panukat.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Names an owner and date but needs a prompt to confirm resources or add a measure.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi kumpirmadong resources ang ipinapangako o ipinapahiya ang hindi nakatapos.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Promises unconfirmed resources or shames someone who did not finish.
